title: AI Agent Risk Registry Entry (PLACEHOLDER)
description: PLACEHOLDER schema for a single AI-agent risk-registry entry. The four scored dimensions below (autonomy, delegated_authority, tool_access, data_exposure) are SAMPLES ONLY and MUST be swapped for RAI's real 12-dimension model when it lands. Do not treat these four as the canonical taxonomy.

description.description: Free-text description of the agent that was classified.

dimensions.description: PLACEHOLDER: 4 sample risk dimensions. SWAP FOR RAI'S REAL 12 DIMENSIONS.

risk_tier.description: Rolled-up risk tier derived from the dimension scores.

challenge.description: Record of the challenger (red-team) pass over the proposal.

flagged.description: True if the challenger flagged any unsupported score.

notes.description: Human-readable challenge notes, including any deterministic overrides that fired.

iterations.description: Number of proposer iterations that ran (bounded; max 2).

submitted_by.description: Who/what submitted the draft (e.g. 'classifier' or an operator id).

approved_by.description: Accountable human who ratified the entry. Null until ratified.

score.description: Risk score for this dimension, 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

evidence.description: Evidence pointers supporting the score (quotes from the description, links, doc refs). May be empty for a draft but SHOULD be populated for a defensible entry.
